paragraphs: Sadako Technologies develops artificial intelligence and robotics applied to waste, and its home page describes technology able to see waste as a human. Among the applications is Max-AI, described on that page as an Autonomous QC waste sorter powered by Sadako AI Technology. Its stated mission is the use of AI technology to disrupt the waste recycling industry.

The about page says the company is Spanish and was incorporated in 2012 to use technology and engineering to build a better world. The same page places the main focus on the recycling field and notes projects starting in other industries. The team is described as mostly engineers and informatics covering AI, Computer Vision, robotics, and business development.

quote.text: Our mission is the use of AI technology to disrupt the waste recycling industry, so next generations can inherit a cleaner and more sustainable environment.
